title: Supplement to Archimedes
author: Johannes Kepler
full_title: Nova stereometria doliorum vinariorum, inprimis Austriaci, figurae omnium aptissimae; et usus in eo virgae cubicae compendiosissimus et plane singularis. Accessit stereometriae Archimedeae supplementum
source: The supplement to Archimedes in Kepler's *Nova stereometria doliorum vinariorum* (Linz: Johannes Planck, at the author's expense, 1615).
transcribed_from: the [page images](https://doi.org/10.3931/e-rara-11051) of the copy in the ETH-Bibliothek, Zürich (Rar 356: 1 q), on e-rara.
summary: Kepler counts 92 kinds of solid made by turning a circle, ellipse, parabola or hyperbola about a line, names them after apples, quinces, plums, lemons and spindles, and finds the volumes of the ring, the apple and the lemon, leaving open problems for Snellius and other geometers.
